comment: Agent Package checker fixture (Common Agent 12.10, with 12.2 to 12.6). Every case is a package: the base package below with the case's edits applied in order. A set edit writes a file's text, a delete edit removes a file, a move edit renames a file, and a json edit sets (or, with remove, deletes) the member at a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) and writes the file back in the package's one spelling, two-space indented with a final newline. Where a case says rehash, the manifest's two digests are then recomputed over the two authored files, under whichever names the package uses; where it says regenerate, NOT.md, RECORDS.md and SYSTEMS.md are generated again from them. Both are done so that a case fails for its own reason and no other. The draft Descriptor is agent-descriptor.json and the install file is agent-runtime-requirements.json; a checker reads their names before the rename, descriptor.json and install.json, as aliases and warns, and a valid case that says warnings gives the number of warnings it expects. A checker MUST accept every valid case and MUST refuse every invalid one, and the check each invalid case names is one that refuses it. THE FIXTURE IS THE AUTHORITY: when a test against it fails, fix the implementation.
spec: SPEC.md 12.10 (the checker), 12.2 (layout), 12.3 (the draft Descriptor), 12.4 (the install file), 12.5 (skills and the generated views), 12.6 (the rules)

checks.layout: the files of 12.2 are present, each authored file under one name only, and the JSON files parse
checks.manifest: plugin.json validates against the pinned Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schema, points at the two authored files by path and digest, is a draft, and carries an address only in $schema, homepage, repository and each from entry's repository
checks.descriptor: the draft Descriptor carries no subject, acts_for or shape, says what the agent refuses and records, and carries no address outside a can_use entry's schema
checks.offering: each offering passes the declaration checks of 6.11
checks.how-run: no job or step declares a how that 12.3 refuses, and every run sits on a job whose how allows one and uses only the placeholders 12.3 lists
checks.install: the install file has its sections, no address of any kind, and well-formed job_seconds and answer
checks.systems: the system names of the Descriptor and the install file are the same set, read through the role alias
checks.ceilings: every spending system has a ceiling, every ceiling names the side that enforces it, and a ceiling over a system the scripts reach with a named credential says runtime
checks.dependencies: every lockfile the install file names is in the package with the digest it names
checks.skills: one skill per offering and per step, no skill without one, and each SKILL.md carries name and description in its frontmatter
checks.mcp: every mcp.json server is a declared system, and mcp.json carries no address
checks.views: NOT.md, RECORDS.md and SYSTEMS.md match a fresh generation byte for byte
checks.hidden: no text file carries a zero-width character, a bidirectional control or a tag-block character

files.net.agentdoc.package/RECORDS.md:
# The records this agent must leave

This is the contract. The agent leaves the following behind, on
every run.

- the document as received — at `*/document`
- the brief as sent

An agent that leaves less than this does not do this job,
whatever else it does well.
files.net.agentdoc.package/SYSTEMS.md:
# The systems this agent needs

Named by what the work needs rather than by product. The access level
is the most this work needs; a deployment that grants more is granting
more than the job requires.

| System | Kind | Access | What the access is for |
|---|---|---|---|
| speech | service | trigger | to read the brief aloud; credential `speech-key`, spends per characters, the caller's material is sent to it |
| documents | directory | read | to read the document |

Whoever deploys this agent binds these systems to their own,
and places any named credential. Nothing here names a product.
files.README.md:
# brief-summarizer

An Agent Package: an Agent Plugin carrying a draft Agent Descriptor (what
the agent does, refuses, needs and records) and its runtime requirements
(what a host must have and do). It carries 2 skill(s). Nobody has run
it: this is a draft to review, not a vouched-for agent.

valid.why: the package the packer builds from a complete spec
a reader's links are addresses rule 3 excepts
an ancestor's repository is excepted too (13.5)
a can_use entry's schema is the Descriptor's one excepted address
an install entry may still spell its name as role for one revision
platform is available where the scripts do not reach the system with a credential the install file names
a script that calls a model at a named point may carry the command the host runs
the two members beside the five sections
a package built before the rename still validates, with a warning for each old name
a server named for a declared system, with no address

invalid.why: a package carries the draft Descriptor under one name
the manifest points at the file the package carries
an install file is part of every package
the pinned schema allows no member it does not list
the schema's name pattern
the manifest names agent-descriptor.json by a digest it no longer has
an address outside the four excepted members
every package is a draft
a draft carries no subject
acts_for is the owner's decision at install (12.6 rule 4)
shapes in the Descriptor, never an address
what records the agent must leave is never left out
an open offering declares its authority and ceilings (6.11)
a written method left to a model to improvise
a program that hands the work to a model
a command sits only on a job whose how says control script
a placeholder 12.3 does not list
the install file carries no address of any kind
the five sections are each present, even empty
the two sets of system names are equal
an unstated enforcing side does not conform
the scripts reach the system with the credential the install file names, so the runtime applies the ceiling
a spending system with no ceiling entry
the lockfile is not the one the install file hashed
every offering has its skill
